title: copilot-survey free-text codebook
description: Categories for coding the free text of one survey series (#2239). One file per series, <series>.json. Categories are one pool; each field codes with its own subset. A code is a category plus onske (wish: true/false). A version is locked before coding starts; waves compare only when coded with the same version, so any change to rules, fields or categories bumps version. Examples are synthetic: never a quote from an answer. codebook_test.go also checks what a schema cannot express: unique category ids, every field's categories in the pool with exactly one catch-all, every pool category used, and fields that exist in the series.

series.description: The survey series the codebook belongs to.

version.description: Goes up on any change to rules or categories.

onske.description: kodes: the coder sets onske per code. alltid/aldri: fixed by the question.

max_codes.description: Most codes (category + onske) one text can get.

categories.description: Category ids from the pool this field codes with.

fields.description: Free-text fields coded with this book, each with its own category set.

rules.description: General coding rules, applied before the category definitions.

id.description: Stored in survey_freetext_codes.category; never reused for a different meaning.

kind.description: Benefit, problem, neutral (use or tool, no valence), or the catch-all (one per field, coded alone).

merge_with.description: Partner category. When either has kappa below 0.6 in a wave, the pair is published as one if the pair reaches 0.6 and the partner is in the field; otherwise the category is hidden. Symmetric.

exclude.description: Hold utenfor, each naming where it goes instead.
